areas.t: Sunday, partly cloudy skies and scattered thunderstorms across portions of the state will limit ozone production. However, light and variable winds will inhibit dispersion and allow pollutants to accumulate. Thus, AQI levels will be high-Good to low-Moderate statewide.  Monday, mixing will increase
